title: The Beast from the Earth and the Mark of the Beast 666
description: John sees another beast rising up from the earth. It has two horns like a lamb, but speaks like a dragon. It exercises the authority of the first beast and causes the earth to worship the one who was healed of its deadly wound. It performs great signs, even making fire fall from heaven, and deceives people into making an image of the first beast. It is given power to give breath to the image so that it can speak, and all who refuse to worship it are killed. The beast forces everyone – small and great, rich and poor, free and slave – to receive a mark on their right hand or forehead, and no one can buy or sell without the mark. The number of the beast's name is 666.
